d:
“KODAK” marks the debut collaboration between New Delhi-based heavyweights KING and Seedhe Maut. Slotting itself as the sixth single from KING’s upcoming project “MM”, his latest collaborative effort features an intricate, yet quirky production work courtesy UKato that aligns with each artist’s detailed storytelling, as they collectively stitch together a vivid story through their sharp and cinematic lyrics. A notable tag-team effort which is exemplified by its raw, authentic feel and the gritty aesthetic of their music, “KODAK” is a rare sight to behold for one and all.
Song Name : KODAK
